name: sidebar-shared
title: Sidebar parts
description: The pieces the sixteen sidebar blocks share: brand header, search box, team switcher, account menu, project and secondary lists, folding calendars, a page header with breadcrumbs, and the small hand-written note that stands where content goes. It installs by itself with any sidebar block; copy the parts you like into your app.

export const formatDay = (date: Date) => `${WEEKDAYS[date.getDay()]}, ${date.getDate()} ${MONTHS[date.getMonth()]}`

export const formatMonth = (date: Date) => `${MONTHS[date.getMonth()]} ${date.getFullYear()}`

              <BrandTile icon={icon} />
              <BrandText title={title} subtitle={`v${selected}`} />
              <Icon name="chevrons-up-down" className="ms-auto" />
            </SidebarMenuButton>
          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
          <DropdownMenuContent className="w-(--radix-dropdown-menu-trigger-width)" align="start">
            <DropdownMenuLabel>Editions</DropdownMenuLabel>
            {versions.map((version) => (
              <DropdownMenuItem key={version} onSelect={() => setSelected(version)}>
                v{version}
                {version === selected ? <Icon name="check" className="ms-auto" label="Current edition" /> : null}
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            ))}
          </DropdownMenuContent>
        </DropdownMenu>
      </SidebarMenuItem>
    </SidebarMenu>
  )
}
